-- Upcoming domestic fixtures from every provider; names are reconciled downstream
-- (football_analysis.teams.team_key) because providers spell clubs differently.
select league, season, match_date, home_team, away_team, event_kind, source, fetched_at
from "football"."main"."recent_events"
where event_kind in ('next', 'fixture') and match_date >= current_date

-- Every landed Football-Data CSV (2005+, first and second divisions), typed.
-- Raw files are read directly: the landing zone is the raw layer for this source.

-- Columns vary by season (e.g. BbAv* until 2019, Avg* after); guarantee every optional one exists.
with raw as (
    select null::varchar as "Time", null::varchar as "HTHG", null::varchar as "HTAG", null::varchar as "HS", null::varchar as "AS", null::varchar as "HST", null::varchar as "AST", null::varchar as "HC", null::varchar as "AC", null::varchar as "HF", null::varchar as "AF", null::varchar as "HY", null::varchar as "AY", null::varchar as "HR", null::varchar as "AR", null::varchar as "Referee", null::varchar as "AvgH", null::varchar as "AvgD", null::varchar as "AvgA", null::varchar as "BbAvH", null::varchar as "BbAvD", null::varchar as "BbAvA", null::varchar as "PSCH", null::varchar as "PSCD", null::varchar as "PSCA", null::varchar as "AvgCH", null::varchar as "AvgCD", null::varchar as "AvgCA"
    where false
    union all by name
    select * from read_csv('/home/scorpiontaj/Projects/Football_analysis/data/raw/[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]/*.csv', union_by_name = true, all_varchar = true, header = true, filename = true, null_padding = true)
),

typed as (
    select
        trim(Div) as league,
        2000 + cast(regexp_extract(filename, '/(\d{2})\d{2}/[^/]+\.csv$', 1) as integer) as season,
        case when length(trim(Date)) = 8 then strptime(trim(Date), '%d/%m/%y')
             else strptime(trim(Date), '%d/%m/%Y') end::date as match_date,
        nullif(trim(Time), '') as kickoff_time,
        trim(HomeTeam) as home_team,
        trim(AwayTeam) as away_team,
        cast(FTHG as integer) as home_goals,
        cast(FTAG as integer) as away_goals,
        try_cast(HTHG as integer) as half_time_home_goals,
        try_cast(HTAG as integer) as half_time_away_goals,
        try_cast(HS as integer) as home_shots_raw,
        try_cast("AS" as integer) as away_shots_raw,
        try_cast(HST as integer) as home_sot_raw,
        try_cast(AST as integer) as away_sot_raw,
        try_cast(HC as integer) as home_corners,
        try_cast(AC as integer) as away_corners,
        try_cast(HF as integer) as home_fouls,
        try_cast(AF as integer) as away_fouls,
        try_cast(HY as integer) as home_yellows,
        try_cast(AY as integer) as away_yellows,
        try_cast(HR as integer) as home_reds,
        try_cast(AR as integer) as away_reds,
        nullif(trim(Referee), '') as referee,
        -- Market average before kick-off (Betbrain average until 2019, then Football-Data's own).
        coalesce(try_cast(AvgH as double), try_cast(BbAvH as double)) as odds_open_home,
        coalesce(try_cast(AvgD as double), try_cast(BbAvD as double)) as odds_open_draw,
        coalesce(try_cast(AvgA as double), try_cast(BbAvA as double)) as odds_open_away,
        -- Pinnacle closing line (2012/13+), the sharpest public benchmark.
        coalesce(try_cast(PSCH as double), try_cast(AvgCH as double)) as odds_close_home,
        coalesce(try_cast(PSCD as double), try_cast(AvgCD as double)) as odds_close_draw,
        coalesce(try_cast(PSCA as double), try_cast(AvgCA as double)) as odds_close_away,
        filename as source_file
    from raw
    where nullif(trim(HomeTeam), '') is not null and nullif(trim(FTHG), '') is not null
)

select
    * exclude (home_shots_raw, away_shots_raw, home_sot_raw, away_sot_raw),
    -- Quarantine impossible shot pairs (same rule as adapters.normalize).
    case when home_sot_raw > home_shots_raw then null else home_shots_raw end as home_shots,
    case when away_sot_raw > away_shots_raw then null else away_shots_raw end as away_shots,
    case when home_sot_raw > home_shots_raw then null else home_sot_raw end as home_sot,
    case when away_sot_raw > away_shots_raw then null else away_sot_raw end as away_sot
from typed

-- One row per played domestic match, 2005+, with margin-free market probabilities.
with results as (
    select r.*, l.league_name, l.country, l.tier, l.in_dashboard
    from "football"."staging"."stg_fd__results" r
    join "football"."reference"."leagues" l using (league)
),

overrounds as (
    select
        *,
        1 / odds_open_home + 1 / odds_open_draw + 1 / odds_open_away as open_overround,
        1 / odds_close_home + 1 / odds_close_draw + 1 / odds_close_away as close_overround
    from results
),

-- Quarantine impossible price sets (bookmaker margin outside 0.98..1.25) instead of
-- letting them distort features or the market benchmark.
priced as (
    select
        * replace (
            case when open_overround between 0.98 and 1.25 then odds_open_home end as odds_open_home,
            case when open_overround between 0.98 and 1.25 then odds_open_draw end as odds_open_draw,
            case when open_overround between 0.98 and 1.25 then odds_open_away end as odds_open_away,
            case when open_overround between 0.98 and 1.25 then open_overround end as open_overround,
            case when close_overround between 0.98 and 1.25 then odds_close_home end as odds_close_home,
            case when close_overround between 0.98 and 1.25 then odds_close_draw end as odds_close_draw,
            case when close_overround between 0.98 and 1.25 then odds_close_away end as odds_close_away,
            case when close_overround between 0.98 and 1.25 then close_overround end as close_overround
        )
    from overrounds
)

select
    md5(concat_ws('|', coalesce(cast(league as varchar), '∅'), coalesce(cast(season as varchar), '∅'), coalesce(cast(match_date as varchar), '∅'), coalesce(cast(home_team as varchar), '∅'), coalesce(cast(away_team as varchar), '∅'))) as match_id,
    league, league_name, country, tier, in_dashboard, season, match_date, kickoff_time,
    home_team, away_team, home_goals, away_goals,
    case when home_goals > away_goals then 'H' when home_goals < away_goals then 'A' else 'D' end as result,
    half_time_home_goals, half_time_away_goals,
    home_shots, away_shots, home_sot, away_sot, home_corners, away_corners,
    home_fouls, away_fouls, home_yellows, away_yellows, home_reds, away_reds, referee,
    odds_open_home, odds_open_draw, odds_open_away,
    odds_close_home, odds_close_draw, odds_close_away,
    open_overround, close_overround,
    (1 / odds_close_home) / close_overround as close_p_home,
    (1 / odds_close_draw) / close_overround as close_p_draw,
    (1 / odds_close_away) / close_overround as close_p_away,
    source_file
from priced

with all_values as (

    select
        result as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "football"."marts"."fct_match"
    group by result

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'H','D','A'
)

select * from "football"."marts"."fct_match"
where close_overround is not null and (close_overround < 0.98 or close_overround > 1.25)

-- Completed top-five seasons must contain every home/away pairing exactly once
-- Known exception: Ligue 1 2019/20 was abandoned in March 2020 (COVID-19) at 279 matches.
with completed as (
    select league, season, count(*) as matches,
           count(distinct home_team) as teams
    from "football"."marts"."fct_match"
    where league in ('E0', 'SP1', 'D1', 'I1', 'F1')
      and season < (select max(season) from "football"."marts"."fct_match")
      and not (league = 'F1' and season = 2019)
    group by all
)
select * from completed where matches <> teams * (teams - 1)

-- European seasons run July..June (covid-delayed 2019/20 finished by August 2020).
select * from "football"."marts"."fct_match"
where match_date < make_date(season, 7, 1) or match_date > make_date(season + 1, 8, 31)
select * from "football"."marts"."fct_match" where match_date > current_date

select * from "football"."marts"."fct_match"
where home_sot > home_shots or away_sot > away_shots

select away_goals
from "football"."marts"."fct_match"
where away_goals is null

select away_team
from "football"."marts"."fct_match"
where away_team is null

select home_goals
from "football"."marts"."fct_match"
where home_goals is null

select home_team
from "football"."marts"."fct_match"
where home_team is null

select league
from "football"."marts"."fct_match"
where league is null

select match_date
from "football"."marts"."fct_match"
where match_date is null

select match_id
from "football"."marts"."fct_match"
where match_id is null

with child as (
    select league as from_field
    from "football"."marts"."fct_match"
    where league is not null
),

parent as (
    select league as to_field
    from "football"."reference"."leagues"
)

select
    from_field

from child
left join parent
    on child.from_field = parent.to_field

where parent.to_field is null

select
    match_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "football"."marts"."fct_match"
where match_id is not null
group by match_id
having count(*) > 1

-- Two rows per match: the team's perspective.
select match_id, league, season, match_date, home_team as team, away_team as opponent, 'Home' as venue,
       home_goals as gf, away_goals as ga, home_shots as shots, home_sot as shots_on_target,
       case result when 'H' then 3 when 'D' then 1 else 0 end as points
from "football"."marts"."fct_match"
union all
select match_id, league, season, match_date, away_team, home_team, 'Away',
       away_goals, home_goals, away_shots, away_sot,
       case result when 'A' then 3 when 'D' then 1 else 0 end
from "football"."marts"."fct_match"

with all_values as (

    select
        venue as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "football"."intermediate"."int_team_matches"
    group by venue

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'Home','Away'
)

with all_values as (

    select
        outcome as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "football"."ml"."ml_match_features"
    group by outcome

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    -1,0,1,2
)

-- A team playing twice on one date would let same-day results leak into features.
with appearances as (
    select match_date, home_team as team from "football"."ml"."ml_match_features"
    union all
    select match_date, away_team from "football"."ml"."ml_match_features"
)
select match_date, team, count(*) from appearances group by all having count(*) > 1

select elo_diff
from "football"."ml"."ml_match_features"
where elo_diff is null

select league, season, match_date, home_team, away_team, count(*) as n
from "football"."ml"."ml_match_features"
group by all
having count(*) > 1

select
    league, season, team,
    count(*) as played,
    sum(points) as points,
    count(*) filter (where points = 3) as wins,
    count(*) filter (where points = 1) as draws,
    count(*) filter (where points = 0) as losses,
    sum(gf) as goals_for,
    sum(ga) as goals_against,
    sum(gf) - sum(ga) as goal_difference,
    round(avg(points), 3) as points_per_game,
    round(avg(gf), 3) as goals_per_game,
    round(avg(ga), 3) as conceded_per_game,
    rank() over (partition by league, season order by sum(points) desc, sum(gf) - sum(ga) desc, sum(gf) desc) as position
from "football"."intermediate"."int_team_matches"
group by league, season, team

select league, season, team, count(*) as n
from "football"."marts"."mart_team_season"
group by all
having count(*) > 1
